_sources.basis: Standard (pay-as-you-go) list price, global endpoint, input <=200K tokens, USD per 1M tokens: 3.5-flash-lite in $0.30 / out $2.50; 3.5-flash in $1.50 / out $9.00; 3.1-pro-preview in $2.00 / out $12.00. Output price covers response AND reasoning tokens (litellm completion_tokens includes reasoning tokens). Cached-input discount and the non-global 50%-credit promo are NOT applied (conservative).
_sources.thinking: flash-lite and flash: reasoning_effort=minimal gives 0 reasoning tokens (measured). pro-preview cannot turn thinking off (minimal/disable still think ~150 tokens, measured); lowest working setting is low, with max_tokens_headroom=1500 added so thinking cannot starve the answer.
